question: US x Iran Effective Ceasefire by September 4?
research:
## Summary

As of September 9, the question is not settled. The latest US strike on Iranian land I could confirm is September 1. If nothing hits Iranian land from September 2 on, a 14-day pause would finish at about noon ET on September 15 or 16. A strike on Iranian land after September 4 would make this market (deadline September 4) resolve No. The biggest uncertainty is the US strikes on Iranian oil tankers on September 5 and 8. Most were clearly at sea, but two were close to Iranian islands or coast, and those could be argued to fall in Iranian "internal waters."

## 1. Resolution source
- The rules don't name a URL, only "a consensus of resolution sources" (major media and official statements). I couldn't open the Polymarket rules page and couldn't find out exactly when the market was created.
- 2026-09-02 (approx.): A Polymarket ladder, "When will the US and Iran achieve a two-week ceasefire?", uses the same 14-day rule. [lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/world/us-x-iran-effective-ceasfire-byptptpt-2-week-pause-20260715194822042)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-09-01: CENTCOM began strikes on Revolutionary Guard (IRGC) targets inside Iran at 12 p.m. ET. Targets included air defenses, radars, mine-laying capability and communications sites. Iranian media reported hits at Bandar Abbas, Jask, Chabahar, Minab, Sirik, Konarak and Qeshm. These clearly qualify. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/01/politics/us-military-strikes-iran), [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/09/01/hormuz-centcom-strikes-trump-iran), [IranWire](https://iranwire.com/en/news/157043-centcom-launches-strikes-on-irgc-positions-in-iran/)
- I found no confirmed US strike on Iranian land from September 2 to 9. I couldn't load the USNI piece of September 4 or the Wikipedia pages to double-check this.
- If September 1 was the last qualifying strike, the pause runs from September 2 to about noon ET on September 15. If strikes carried into early September 2 ET, it would run to September 16.
- The tanker strikes are the main judgment call:
  - 2026-09-05: US forces disabled the tanker M/T Downy "off the coast of Kharg Island" and M/T Stark 1 "near Jask", and destroyed M/T Kylo in the Gulf of Oman. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/05/middleeast/iran-us-tanker-kharg-intl), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/05/us-iran-oil-tankers-navy-missile-attack.html)
  - 2026-09-08: Five tankers were hit: four in the Gulf of Oman and M/T Derya "near Kharg Island". [The Hill](https://thehill.com/policy/defense/6077471-us-strikes-irgc-oil-tankers/), [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/08/politics/us-targets-iran-tankers)
  - Strikes at sea are excluded by the rules. The Kharg Island and Jask cases are the only ones a resolver might treat as internal waters, which would mean No.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-08/09: The US struck five tankers. Iran said it fired missiles at a US base in Jordan and attacked 10 ships. CENTCOM said "all IRGC attempted attacks failed." [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/9/us-destroys-five-iranian-tankers-iran-retaliates-with-attacks-on-jordan-base)
- 2026-09-06: Parliament speaker Ghalibaf threatened a "more painful" response, and the US naval blockade continued. [CBS](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-us-trump-diesel-gas-prices-labor-day/), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/6/iran-touts-military-response-as-us-maintains-blockade-hits-tankers)
- 2026-09-05: The tanker strikes came after the IRGC fired ballistic missiles at a US carrier and destroyer. [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/09/05/nx-s1-5959159/us-iran-warships-targeted)
- 2026-09-01/02: After the land strikes, Iran fired missiles at Jordan, Bahrain, Kuwait and Iraqi Kurdistan, and Trump warned of "much harder" strikes. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/2/iran-us-exchange-new-attacks-who-was-hit-in-latest-strikes)
- 2026-08-30: The US struck two rocket launchers on Larak Island, an Iranian island in the Strait of Hormuz. It was the first US strike on Iran since late July. Iran hit back at Jordan on August 31. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/30/politics/us-iran-strikes-larak-island), [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3365782/us-forces-strike-two-iranian-launchers-irans-larak-island-us-official-says)
- 2026-08-17: The 60-day US-Iran memorandum expired with no deal. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/17/us-iran-memorandum-of-understanding-expires-how-and-why-it-fell-apart)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-08-18: GlobalSecurity said there had been no US strike inside Iran for 19 straight nights. The gap from late July to August 30 was about 29 days, so 14-day pauses have happened before. [GlobalSecurity](https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/ops/iran-war-20260818.htm)
- 2026-07-07 to 07-12: After the earlier ceasefire collapsed, the US struck on several days in a row (more than 300 targets over three nights). Escalation episodes have tended to be short bursts of a few days. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/13/missile-strikes-and-attacks-on-ships-reported-around-strait-of-hormuz)
- Since September 1, the US has answered Iranian missile attacks on its ships by hitting tankers at sea rather than targets on land.

## 5. Other forecasts
- About 2026-09-02, the Polymarket two-week-ceasefire ladder showed: by September 4, 24%; September 11, 46%; September 18, 64%; September 30, 73%. [lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/world/us-x-iran-effective-ceasfire-byptptpt-2-week-pause-20260715194822042)
- I couldn't find current prices, Manifold or Kalshi equivalents, or expert forecasts.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution (about September 18)
- About September 15 or 16, noon ET: the 14-day pause would be complete if no qualifying strike happens.
- Escalation risk: Iran keeps firing missiles at US ships and at Jordan, and Trump has threatened bigger strikes. Any US strike on Iran's coast, islands or ports, such as Bandar Abbas, Qeshm, Larak or Kharg, would end the run.
- If tankers are hit again near Kharg or other Iranian ports, resolvers will have to decide whether those waters count as internal waters.
- Around September 9: Trump said talks with Iran are possible and the war would end after the November 3 midterms. [Al Jazeera liveblog](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/9/9/iran-war-live-us-hits-iranian-tankers-irgc-attacks-us-base-in-jordan)
